author_knowledge: Self-authored with coding-agent assistance. Author knows development fixtures, policies, reviewer, and graders. No live held-out inference used for wording, answer, attack, or defense selection.
limitations: New decision-rule templates, not unseen tools or independently authored attacks. Resource/action boilerplate and attack mechanisms are shared across cases and with development.
Eight authored decision families with five distinct procedures each. Task-bootstrap intervals do not remove family correlation. The lexical overlap audit is not a semantic independence certificate.
The suite emphasizes rule application on small synthetic records. It does not cover confidential-input receipts, external integrations, adaptive attackers, or arbitrary disclosure encodings.
